fields.value: All customers, including no activity in a particular month, carried cumulative balance

value: Deposit positive; withdrawal and purchase negative; initial balance zero
Exclude baseline first month only after calculating previous total
fields.rationale: Balance flows not defined by request; all nondeposit transaction types observed are account expenditures

value.expression: Continuous months from first to last recorded transaction; first-of-month snapshot strictly before that day; baseline first month excluded after lag

fields.value: Zero net in inactive months; carry cumulative account balance

value.description: Per customer monthly signed transaction net, cumulatively sum from zero, clip each customer closing to MAX(closing,0), sum all customers, lag aggregate one calendar month. Remove first month only after lag.

fields.rationale: Cumulative account balance interpretation; negative balances clipped per customer after accumulation, not monthly net or aggregate
